import json, os, time
import pyarrow.parquet as pq
from transformers import AutoTokenizer

DATA_DIR = "/root/prism_collapse_mixing/data"
CACHE_DIR = "/root/autodl-tmp/.hf_cache"
PARQUET_DIR = "/root/autodl-tmp/fineweb_data"
TARGET = 400_000_000
SKIP_014 = 19881  # rows used for probe+val

tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained("EleutherAI/pythia-410m-deduped", cache_dir=CACHE_DIR)

count = 0
total_tok = 0
t0 = time.time()
out_path = os.path.join(DATA_DIR, "real_pool.jsonl")

def process_rows(texts, start_idx, f_out):
    global count, total_tok
    for i in range(start_idx, len(texts)):
        if total_tok >= TARGET:
            return True
        text = texts[i].as_py()
        if not text or not text.strip():
            continue
        tokens = tokenizer.encode(text, add_special_tokens=False)
        n = len(tokens)
        f_out.write(json.dumps({"text": text}) + "\n")
        count += 1
        total_tok += n
        if count % 10000 == 0:
            elapsed = time.time() - t0
            rate = total_tok / elapsed
            eta = (TARGET - total_tok) / rate / 60 if rate > 0 else 0
            print(f"  {count:,} samples, {total_tok/1e6:.1f}M/{TARGET/1e6:.0f}M tokens "
                  f"({rate/1e6:.2f}M tok/s, ETA {eta:.0f}min)", flush=True)
    return total_tok >= TARGET

with open(out_path, "w") as f_out:
    # Phase A: remaining rows from 014
    p014 = os.path.join(PARQUET_DIR, "014_00000.parquet")
    print(f"Phase A: reading 014 (skip first {SKIP_014} rows)...", flush=True)
    table = pq.read_table(p014, columns=["text"])
    texts = table.column("text")
    print(f"  {len(texts)} total rows, processing from row {SKIP_014}", flush=True)
    done = process_rows(texts, SKIP_014, f_out)
    del texts, table
    print(f"  After 014: {count:,} samples, {total_tok/1e6:.1f}M tokens", flush=True)

    if not done:
        # Phase B: wait for 000 download then process
        p000 = os.path.join(PARQUET_DIR, "000_00000.parquet")
        expected_size = 2_147_292_183  # 2.0GB from wget header
        print(f"\nPhase B: waiting for 000 download...", flush=True)
        while True:
            if os.path.exists(p000):
                sz = os.path.getsize(p000)
                if sz >= expected_size * 0.99:  # allow small tolerance
                    # verify it's a valid parquet
                    try:
                        pq.read_metadata(p000)
                        print(f"  000 ready ({sz/1e9:.2f}GB)", flush=True)
                        break
                    except:
                        pass
                print(f"  000 downloading: {sz/1e9:.2f}GB / {expected_size/1e9:.2f}GB "
                      f"({sz*100/expected_size:.1f}%)", flush=True)
            else:
                print("  000 not found yet...", flush=True)
            time.sleep(60)

        print("  Reading 000 parquet...", flush=True)
        table = pq.read_table(p000, columns=["text"])
        texts = table.column("text")
        print(f"  {len(texts)} rows", flush=True)
        process_rows(texts, 0, f_out)
        del texts, table
        print(f"  After 000: {count:,} samples, {total_tok/1e6:.1f}M tokens", flush=True)

elapsed = time.time() - t0
size_mb = os.path.getsize(out_path) / 1e6
avg_tok = total_tok / count if count > 0 else 0
print(f"\n{'='*60}")
print(f"TRAIN POOL SUMMARY")
print(f"{'='*60}")
print(f"  Samples: {count:,}")
print(f"  Tokens:  {total_tok:,} ({total_tok/1e6:.1f}M)")
print(f"  Avg tok: {avg_tok:.0f}")
print(f"  File:    {size_mb:.1f} MB")
print(f"  Time:    {elapsed:.0f}s ({elapsed/60:.1f}min)")
print(f"\nDONE", flush=True)
PYEOF
echo "WRITTEN"
